title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Working Corpus and Multilingual Translation Readers
description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It retains the German R823 source-control reader, the English working corpus, the 473-page Spanish and 494-page French R823 readers, Interslavic Latin/Cyrillic readers, and bounded CJK/Korean, Slavic, Arabic/Persian, and Indonesian components.

New Paper 30 source-control supplement: 00a_Noether_German_R823_Paper30_HardMath_AuditedWorkingReader_20260718.pdf is a 466-page German cumulative working reader with a bounded direct-source audit of Paper 30 source pages 37-61. File 15 groups the corrected TeX, exact R823 diff, direct source slice, enlarged symbol witnesses, two-pass LuaLaTeX build log, hashes, and audit note.

The audit restores source-visible Greek exponent variables, a sigma/varrho distinction, a Fraktur-variable distinction, source line flow, and German quotation typography. It also records and rejects one web-session false positive: ordinary German durch had been misread as literal dnrch from the Fraktur glyph shape. The corrected cumulative source rebuilt to 466 pages with zero forbidden diagnostics.

French R823 reader: 02d_Noether_French_R823_Cumulative_WorkingTranslation_20260718.pdf remains the 494-page cumulative French working translation with its exact TeX/evidence closure in file 14. Existing translations have not been silently declared synchronized to the new German Paper 30 patch.

Status caveat: these are substantial source-control working editions and translations, not critical editions, complete Paper 30 or whole-corpus certification, native-language certificates, peer review, mathematical proof checking, or guarantees that every symbol and translation choice is error-free.

GitHub: corrections and improvements can be proposed through issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Reader-first public surface with German R823 source control plus a bounded Paper 30 hard-math source audit; English, Spanish, and French cumulative working readers; Interslavic readers; and bounded CJK/Korean, Slavic, Arabic/Persian, and Indonesian components. Not a critical edition, complete paper or corpus certification, native-language certification, peer review, or proof checking.
